test_title: PYST 26: SSC JE ME - Reasoning (Held on: 22 March 2021 (Morning)
subject: reasoning
question:
Nine friends, Ananya, Bryson, Catalina, Druva, Eva, Fanish, Girik, Hariraj and Kunj are, have gone for a candle light dinner, and they are sitting around a circle facing the centre. Fanish is 4th to the right of Ananya, who is 3rd to the right of Bryson. Kunj is 4th to the left of Bryson and 3rd to the right of Druva. Catalina is 3rd to the right of Hariraj. Eva is 2nd to the left of Girik.

Who is sitting between Girik and Eva?
solution:
Given information:

1.Fanish is 4th to the right of Ananya, who is 3rd to the right of Bryson.

2. Kunj is 4th to the left of Bryson and 3rd to the right of Druva.

3. Catalina is 3rd to the right of Hariraj.

4. Eva is 2nd to the left of Girik.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c14d40413c964eeda385293c496a265c2264634ecef1c6b2f09435736df2a2b.png] 

Hence, **"Fanish" **is between Girik and Eva.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__**

Use of the word "Who" / "AND". 

Suppose for an example 

1. 

In a circular seating arrangement facing center, Pis fourth to the left of Q, (WHILE / AND / BUT ) 2nd to the left of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3841dd1bb9bb93bab05eb92e3f6148e2123a4c30c59837298a4aaa9253574033.png] 

**2. **

In a circle seating arrangement facing center Pis 3rd to the right of Q (WHILE / WHOM / WHO) is 2nd to the left of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4deca97e3931725458eb919d88a6e14edebee2abcc160ab82225968a2cdc22e7.png]
